The '''vaapad''', not to be confused with '''Juyo''', was a creature native to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] energy-[[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Sarapin/Legends|Sarapin]] and its [[Moon/Legends|moons]].

Vaapads were brown ball-shaped, multi-tentacled creatures with two yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and multiple tentacles used to [[Death/Legends|kill]] prey. A vaapad attacked by striking its prey with its tentacles so quickly that they were nothing but a blur to the naked eye. There was no way to tell how many tentacles it had unless it was dead. The tentacles varied; most had at least seven, while the largest specimen ever examined had twenty-three.

[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] developed a [[Form VII/Legends|lightsaber style]] based upon the vaapad. The style used quick and deadly strikes to overcome the enemy, much like how the vaapad would use its tentacles on prey. Windu created this style with aid from [[Sora Bulq/Legends|Sora Bulq]]. However, Windu and his former apprentice, [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]], were considered the form's only masters.
